arcade._notes: A7 arcade events (GAME_DESIGN 19.22). Crashes are rolled when a drone lands: chance = 1 - exp(-flight seconds x perFlightSecond x drone risk / 0.004 x weather x (1 + parts' crashRiskPct)). The flight's SD cards still come back; the drone goes to the workbench for repairSec (pay rushRepairPct of its price to fix it now). No events until graceJobs jobs are delivered; at most one drone per zone in repair. The other events are rolled once per game day (chancePerDay) and happen at a random moment that day. All numbers picked by Claude in A7.
